provenance.subject: Supplied Sage research files bearing Haiying Shan copyright notices

decision: Prepare and publish the reviewed source under the Apache License 2.0, retaining original attribution, the upstream MIT terms recorded for supplied files, provenance records and dependency notices.
confirmation_basis: The project owner confirmed authorization to publish the supplied code and adaptations on 2026-10-20 and initially selected MIT when permitted to choose a license. On 2026-10-26 the owner selected the Apache License 2.0 for the project as a whole. The supplied Sage files keep their recorded MIT redistribution terms and original attribution; the project-wide Apache-2.0 grant does not remove them.
distribution_scope: Retained release functionality and corresponding provenance only; removed optional combinatorial implementations/excerpts are not distributed.
